_comment: What Larry can promise across the table on a discovery call. Commercial terms (plans, giveback, contract) are NOT here -- the screen reads those from terms.json so the two cannot drift. Everything below was checked against the live store on the 'verified' date; re-check it when shipping rates or the price ladder change.

promise.label: Decoration
promise.text: Screen print, DTF transfer, embroidery. Artwork is built to suit the method, so decide the method before the art.

promise.label: Delivery
promise.text: Free pickup at the church office in the Dayton area. Everyone else ships: in-house items $8 to the door, free over $100. Print-on-demand items ship at the vendor's rate.

promise.label: Typical price points
promise.text: $20–22 tee (up to $26 in 4XL) · $35–40 crewneck or hoodie · $25 hat · $16–18 toddler tee

promise.label: Sizes available
promise.text: Adult S–4XL on most blanks, some to 5XL. Youth and toddler on request.
